quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What headlights should you use when driving in fog, rain, or snow?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, rain, and snow. High beams reflect back at you in these conditions, creating glare that makes it hard to see.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks does it take to affect your driving?
questions.explanation: Even one drink affects your driving ability. Do not drive after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: If you need to slow down on a slippery road, what should you do first?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: First, take your foot off the gas pedal. If you need to slow down more, gently press the brake pedal with steady, light pressure.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after drinking alcohol reduce impairment?

options.text: Yes, it decreases blood alcohol concentration.
Yes, it cancels the alcohol's effect.
No, it has no effect on blood alcohol concentration.
No, it increases blood alcohol concentration.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it has no effect on blood alcohol concentration.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not lower your blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it cannot make you sober or change your blood alcohol concentration.

questions.question: What does an orange sign indicate?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs with black symbols warn of construction, maintenance, or emergency work.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following, except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks.

questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. It does not depend on how fit you are or how well you can handle alcohol.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of driving hazards. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: Which drugs can affect your driving ability?
questions.explanation: Many drugs affect driving ability, including illegal drugs and over-the-counter or prescription medicines. Driving while impaired by any drug can be a crime.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Stop only if other cars are approaching.
Stop only if other cars are in the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop, let others go first, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means passing is:

options.text: Allowed from the side with the solid yellow line.
Allowed from the side with the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allowed from the side with the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: When a solid yellow line is next to a broken yellow line, you can pass from the side with the broken line. You cannot pass from the side with the solid line.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: A "No stopping" sign means you can only stop if a police officer tells you to, or to:

options.text: Park for less than five minutes.

questions.explanation: A "No stopping" sign allows you to stop only to obey a traffic signal, obey a police officer, or prevent a crash with another vehicle.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.
Watch for other drivers entering the same lane.

questions.explanation: Never change lanes while inside an intersection. Always look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes. Watch for other drivers who may be moving into the same lane.

questions.question: A child under age eight and shorter than ____ must sit in an approved child safety seat while the vehicle is moving.
questions.explanation: The law requires children under age eight and shorter than 4 feet, 9 inches, or weighing less than 100 pounds, to use an approved child safety seat. They should not use a regular seat belt until it fits them properly.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic is merging from the left.
The right lane ends. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. You must move left to another lane.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, you should:

options.text: Brake as hard as you can.

questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, release the gas or brake to regain control. Steer in the direction of the skid to help stabilize the vehicle.

questions.question: In which situation is passing always forbidden?

options.text: The car ahead is turning left.
You are on a one-way street with two lanes.
The car ahead is stopped for a pedestrian crossing.
The car ahead is parking along the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car ahead is stopped for a pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: You must never pass a car that has stopped at a crosswalk to let a pedestrian cross.

questions.question: When driving in the rain, you must use:
questions.explanation: In rain, use your low beam headlights to see and be seen by other drivers.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light at an intersection works the same as:
questions.explanation: A flashing red signal means you must stop and let all other traffic go first.
